text: The Krull-Schmidt theorem says: in a group with ACC and DCC on subgroups, any two direct product decompositions into indecomposable factors are:
choices: isomorphic (the factors are the same up to order and isomorphism)
explanation: Krull-Schmidt: decompositions into indecomposable direct factors are unique up to permutation and isomorphism (analogous to unique factorisation for groups).
